chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 262 – Xiangliu Fang Bag-n-Bags Qiongqi, Treasure Hall Reveal
chapter_meta_description: The ice formation collapses as Uncle White’s Fuxi Staffs shine. Xiangliu Fang arrives, bags 18 Qiongqi puppets, and the real prize—Treasure Hall—is revealed. But the demon tribes still wait outside.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 262 – The Fiendgod Cleanup Crew
og_description: Formation broken, puppets bagged, and “Treasure Hall” carved into the wall. Xiangliu Fang is worth every coin of that contract.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 262: Uncle White’s Genius Play
twitter_description: The Whitewater Hound cracks a Primal-level formation, then Xiangliu Fang shows up and scoops all 18 Qiongqi puppets like they’re toys. Treasure Hall, here we come.

lore_anchors.definition: A mythical beast from Chinese folklore, one of the Four Perils; depicted as a winged tiger that devours humans. In Xianxia, it is often used as a template for powerful combat puppets.

A formation technique named after Fuxi, the legendary first of the Three Sovereigns in Chinese myth who invented the trigrams. The staffs are used to ‘pin’ space and harmonize with or disrupt enemy arrays.
A Fiendgod bodyguard contracted to Shaoyan Nong; possesses immense raw strength and regenerative abilities, making him a formidable asset in the Immortal Estate trial.
One of the five main branch halls within the Immortal Estate, presumably containing valuable treasures and resources left by the estate’s original owner.
A classic defensive formation that coordinates multiple cultivators to share damage and amplify their combined power while covering all cardinal and center positions.
